title: BAM! Bayesian Anything Model: a foundation model for generative computational imaging
abstract: arXiv:2609.39660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative models are transforming Bayesian computational imaging, yet the field still lacks physics-aware foundation models. Current practice falls into two camps. Large foundation image models are deployed as plug-and-play priors with zero-shot approximate likelihood guidance, which introduces significant bias and computational cost. Physics-aware generative models avoid this bias, but each is tied to a specific dataset, task and instrument. We introduce BAM (Bayesian Anything Model), a lightweight foundation model for few-step, physics-aware posterior sampling that generalises robustly to unseen data and tasks, zero-shot or with minimal finetuning. BAM upgrades the operator-conditioned Reconstruct Anything Model (RAM) backbone (Terris et al.) into a conditional flow map, so instrument physics is specified at inference time rather than fixed during training. BAM has just 36M parameters and is pre-trained jointly on large image corpor

translated_title: BAM！贝叶斯万物模型：面向生成式计算成像的基础模型
translated_abstract: 生成式模型正在变革贝叶斯计算成像，但该领域仍缺乏具备物理感知能力的基础模型。目前的实践分为两大阵营：大型基础图像模型被作为即插即用的先验，配合零样本的近似似然引导，这会引入显著的偏差和巨大的计算成本；而物理感知的生成式模型虽然避免了这种偏差，但每个模型都被绑定于特定的数据集、任务和仪器。我们提出了BAM（贝叶斯万物模型），这是一个轻量级的基础模型，用于少步数的物理感知后验采样，能够稳健地泛化到未见过的数据和任务，实现零样本或仅需极少微调即可使用。BAM将算子条件化的Reconstruct Anything Model（RAM）骨干网络（Terris等人）升级为条件流映射，使仪器物理特性在推理时指定，而非在训练时固定。BAM仅有3600万参数，并在大型图像语料库上进行联合预训练。
tldr: 本文提出仅含3600万参数的轻量级基础模型BAM，通过将RAM骨干升级为条件流映射，使仪器物理特性可在推理时灵活指定，从而实现少步数的物理感知后验采样，并能零样本或仅需极少微调即可泛化到未见过的数据和任务。
en_tdlr: BAM is a lightweight 36M-parameter foundation model that upgrades the RAM backbone with conditional flow maps, allowing instrument physics to be specified at inference time for few-step, physics-aware posterior sampling that generalizes zero-shot (or with minimal finetuning) to unseen data and tasks in computational imaging.
